target.name: publish-remote-all
target.description: Publish mailbox jars to Nexus develop-snapshot

arg.value: set -e; NEXUS_BASE_URL='${env.NEXUS_BASE_URL}'; NEXUS_USER='${env.NEXUS_USER}'; NEXUS_PASSWORD='${env.NEXUS_PASSWORD}'; JAR_REPO='develop-snapshot'; if [ -z "$NEXUS_BASE_URL" ] || [ -z "$NEXUS_USER" ] || [ -z "$NEXUS_PASSWORD" ]; then echo 'Missing Nexus configuration. Required: NEXUS_BASE_URL, NEXUS_USER, NEXUS_PASSWORD'; exit 1; fi; RAW_BASE=$(printf '%s' "$NEXUS_BASE_URL" | sed 's/#.*$//' | sed 's:/*$::'); module_list='zm-native zm-common zm-soap zm-client zm-store'; for module in $module_list; do pub_dir="$HOME/.zcs-deps/zimbra/$module"; [ -d "$pub_dir" ] || continue; jar_path=$(find "$pub_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "$module-*.jar" ! -name "$module-latest.integration.jar" ! -name "$module-local.jar" -printf '%T@\t%p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -t "$(printf '\t')" -k1,1rn | head -1 | cut -f2-); [ -n "$jar_path" ] || continue; jar_name=$(basename "$jar_path"); jar_version=$(echo "$jar_name" | sed -E "s/^$module-([0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*)\.jar$/\1/"); if [ -z "$jar_version" ] || [ "$jar_version" = "$jar_name" ]; then echo "Could not parse version from jar name: $jar_name"; exit 1; fi; case "$jar_version" in *-develop-snapshot|*-snapshot) ;; *) jar_version="$jar_version-develop-snapshot" ;; esac; upload_name="$module-$jar_version.jar"; url="$RAW_BASE/repository/$JAR_REPO/zimbra/$module/$jar_version/$upload_name"; body_file=$(mktemp); header_file=$(mktemp); echo "Uploading $upload_name -> $url"; http_code=$(curl --silent --show-error --user "$NEXUS_USER:$NEXUS_PASSWORD" --header 'Expect:' --upload-file "$jar_path" --dump-header "$header_file" --output "$body_file" --write-out '%{http_code}' "$url" || true); case "$http_code" in 2??) echo "Upload successful: $upload_name (HTTP $http_code)"; ;; 400|409) resp=$(tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' < "$body_file" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$resp" in *already*exist*|*cannot*be*updated*|*conflict*|*duplicate*) echo "Upload skipped (already exists): $upload_name (HTTP $http_code)"; ;; *) echo "Upload failed for $upload_name (HTTP $http_code)"; [ -s "$header_file" ] && sed -n '1,120p' "$header_file"; [ -s "$body_file" ] && sed -n '1,200p' "$body_file"; rm -f "$body_file" "$header_file"; exit 1;; esac ;; *) echo "Upload failed for $upload_name (HTTP $http_code)"; [ -s "$header_file" ] && sed -n '1,120p' "$header_file"; [ -s "$body_file" ] && sed -n '1,200p' "$body_file"; rm -f "$body_file" "$header_file"; exit 1 ;; esac; rm -f "$body_file" "$header_file"; done

target.name: publish-remote-pkgs-all
target.description: Alias target for publishing package artifacts

target.name: publish-remote-package
target.description: Publish package artifacts to Nexus APT/Yum repos

arg.value: set -e; ROOT='build/dist'; NEXUS_BASE_URL='${env.NEXUS_BASE_URL}'; NEXUS_USER='${env.NEXUS_USER}'; NEXUS_PASSWORD='${env.NEXUS_PASSWORD}'; APT_REPO='package-repo-apt'; YUM_REPO='package-repo-yum'; MODULE_PATH='zimbra/zm-mailbox/${package.snapshot.version}'; if [ -z "$NEXUS_BASE_URL" ] || [ -z "$NEXUS_USER" ] || [ -z "$NEXUS_PASSWORD" ]; then echo 'Missing Nexus configuration. Required: NEXUS_BASE_URL, NEXUS_USER, NEXUS_PASSWORD'; exit 1; fi; RAW_BASE=$(printf '%s' "$NEXUS_BASE_URL" | sed 's/#.*$//' | sed 's:/*$::'); API_BASE="$RAW_BASE/service/rest/v1/components"; PACKAGE_FILES=$(find "$ROOT" -type f \( -name '*.deb' -o -name '*.rpm' -o -name '*.tgz' -o -name '*.tar.gz' \)); if [ -z "$PACKAGE_FILES" ]; then echo 'No package artifacts found in build/dist'; exit 1; fi; while IFS= read -r f; do rel=$(echo "$f" | sed "s|^$ROOT/||"); dir=$(dirname "$rel"); file_name=$(basename "$f"); body_file=$(mktemp); header_file=$(mktemp); case "$f" in *.deb) repo="$APT_REPO"; url="$API_BASE?repository=$repo"; echo "Uploading $f -> $repo via Components API"; http_code=$(curl --silent --show-error --user "$NEXUS_USER:$NEXUS_PASSWORD" --request POST "$url" -F "apt.asset=@$f" --dump-header "$header_file" --output "$body_file" --write-out '%{http_code}' || true) ;; *.rpm) repo="$YUM_REPO"; yum_dir="$MODULE_PATH/$dir"; url="$API_BASE?repository=$repo"; echo "Uploading $f -> $repo via Components API (yum.directory=$yum_dir)"; http_code=$(curl --silent --show-error --user "$NEXUS_USER:$NEXUS_PASSWORD" --request POST "$url" -F "yum.directory=$yum_dir" -F "yum.asset=@$f" -F "yum.asset.filename=$file_name" --dump-header "$header_file" --output "$body_file" --write-out '%{http_code}' || true) ;; *.tgz|*.tar.gz) echo "Skipping non-apt/yum artifact: $f"; rm -f "$body_file" "$header_file"; continue ;; *) echo "Skipping unknown artifact type: $f"; rm -f "$body_file" "$header_file"; continue ;; esac; case "$http_code" in 2??) echo "Upload successful: $file_name (HTTP $http_code)" ;; 400|409) resp=$(tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' < "$body_file" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$resp" in *already*exist*|*cannot*be*updated*|*duplicate*|*conflict*) echo "Upload skipped (already exists): $file_name (HTTP $http_code)" ;; *) echo "Upload failed for $f (HTTP $http_code)"; [ -s "$header_file" ] && echo 'Response headers:' && sed -n '1,80p' "$header_file"; [ -s "$body_file" ] && echo 'Server response:' && sed -n '1,160p' "$body_file"; rm -f "$body_file" "$header_file"; exit 1 ;; esac ;; *) echo "Upload failed for $f (HTTP $http_code)"; [ -s "$header_file" ] && echo 'Response headers:' && sed -n '1,80p' "$header_file"; [ -s "$body_file" ] && echo 'Server response:' && sed -n '1,160p' "$body_file"; rm -f "$body_file" "$header_file"; exit 1 ;; esac; rm -f "$body_file" "$header_file"; done <<< "$PACKAGE_FILES"
